corrections.reason: Simeon and Levi took their sister (እኅታቸውን, Dinah) after slaying the men of Shechem; visually the glyphs are እኅታቸውን.
In the Ge'ez citation of Genesis 34:30, the particle is ዳዕሙ ('rather/moreover') and the 1st-person singular verb matching አነ is እትቀጠቀጥ ('I shall be crushed').
Joined with ላለ on the next line, the word is ስላለ ('because he said thus'), with 6th-order ስ clearly printed at the end of line 12.
The Ge'ez interrogative adverb repeated from line 16-17 is እፎኑ ('how is it?').
Both visually on the page and grammatically with the 3rd-person feminine suffix in መስሏት, the printed word is የነቀፈባት ('thinking that He disparaged it to her').
